businesses.business: alternative asset management and real estate services

offering_description.value: Provides management services to publicly traded and private real estate companies and related businesses, including externally managed REITs, operating companies and real estate funds. Earns fees for managing properties and corporate operations, and for capital raising and investment activity. Also manages hotels, senior living and net lease real estate through its clients.

primary_services.value: real estate asset management; property management; business management for REITs; real estate investment management; development and construction supervision

customer_segment.value: B2B: externally managed REITs, real estate operating companies, private capital vehicles and tenants of managed properties

end_markets.value: commercial real estate; office; industrial and logistics; net lease; hotels; senior living

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: base management fees, incentive fees and advisory fees from managed REITs and operating companies; service fees: property management, construction supervision and reimbursed costs charged to managed entities
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: external manager of real estate companies and properties, paid by managed clients; financial intermediary: asset manager sponsoring and managing REITs and private real estate funds for investors

geography_served.value: US national: Managed properties across the United States, with some in Canada, Puerto Rico and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: management of REITs and operating companies, property management and private real estate capital

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: management contracts directly with sponsored and affiliated REITs and operating companies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: SEC registered investment adviser rules, REIT governance rules, real estate licensing and stock exchange requirements

notes: Details on geography and client list come from general knowledge and may have changed.
